contentPattern: Optional rows, each with one cell: a row with a link (or a path/URL as text) sets the query index source (default /query-index.json); a row with plain text sets the input placeholder (e.g. 'Busca'). Renders a pill-shaped field: round search badge, floating-label input, round clear (x) button; results list (path + title rows) below.
reuseGuidance: Use wherever a standalone search field is needed on a page. Author the placeholder text in the block; the index defaults to the site query index.
usageDescription: Site / help-center search field (pill input with search icon and clear button) with client-side results from the query index.
